senses.definition: Where one is prohibited to enter.
senses.example: You can play wherever you want, but remember that the cemetery is out of bounds.

senses.definition: Beyond the bounds of civility, morality, or normality.
senses.example: You were out of bounds to call him a criminal.

senses.definition: Outside the area of play; beyond the sideline of a playing field or court.
senses.example: The ball went out of bounds.

senses.definition: A sideline marking the edge of a playing field or court.
An instance of a player or the ball going out of bounds.
senses.example: Although Oklahoma outyarded the Jays 339 to 155, Kansas fought magnificently and earned its 13-13 tie. Royal's punting had begun to jell. He kicked four out-of-bounds against the Crimson and Blue.

senses.definition: Ground that one is not permitted to enter, or that is outside the permitted playing area.
senses.example: Out of bounds starts at the white stake.
